moved.label: Reallocation between spot and futures
moved.why_ru: This is not a money transfer, a fee, or a profit or loss. Spot and futures run on one OKX account with the same USDT. The system splits the account's current value, not its starting value: spot 80%, futures 10%, active spot 0%. So futures now get $465.44 less than their starting share plus their own result, and spot gets the same amount more. Of this difference, +$60.39 is the futures' share of the change in the whole account's value, and −$525.83 is how the shares drifted between recalculations: coin prices move all the time, and the system rebalances only when the gap passes a threshold.
